question: Can a bounded shared two-parameter joint-load tolerance improve I-60 accepted/fallback proposals without sacrificing useful corrections or point-error tails?
information_boundary: Offline saved-state replay only. Live LQR, momentum observer, feedforward and incoming-drive preparation remain unchanged. Solver truth is used only for retrospective selection/evaluation, never as an inference input.
prior_inspection: All three episodes and I-61 failures were previously examined. Leave-one-start-out assessment is retrospective internal validation, not an unseen holdout or independent physical trial.
original_campaign: I-58 native gain-scheduled LQR Gazebo/DART Mars figure-eight; initial common shaft -1.0,+0.3,+0.9 rad, yaw 45 deg, command caps [1.5,0.6,0.6 N m,0.3,0.3 m/s]. Existing exact 5 ms state and prior applied input used by I-60/I-61.
candidate_source: Frozen I-60 proposals, acceptance flags and I-61 extra-joint residual/validity/force/radius. No proposal reranking or geometry regeneration.
gate_equation: keep = i60_accepted AND proposed_valid AND max(abs(extra_joint_residual_Nm)) <= a + (b * radius_m) * force_norm_N
zero_boundary: a=0 is an explicit offline extension; exact zero threshold admits only exact zero residual at valid rows. Direct comparison avoids division by zero. The runtime load_compatibility API and its a>0 requirement are unchanged.

grid.construction: integer_index * 0.005; same a,b for all three joint residual rows and all phases

baselines.A: I-60 accepted proposal else native; no additional veto
baselines.I61: a=0.03,b=0.10; must reproduce I-61 C policy flags and primary metrics

primary_mask: 1 <= time_s < 41, total truth normal load >=1 N, unique dominant family >=90% total load; fixed I-61 eligible mask. Dominant support is not strict single contact.
point_mask: Primary mask AND finite N point, finite A point (accepted proposal else N), and finite truth equivalent point. Fixed for every parameter and policy; never restrict distance metrics to retained proposals. Unaccepted raw proposals do not exclude a valid native fallback. Distances in mm to truth equivalent point.
metrics: useful corrections retained (native wrong, A right, tuned right)
equivalent-point SSE, RMS, exact p95 and maximum
stable oracle geometry compatibility as diagnostic only

training_gates.pooled_family_errors_max: A errors on identical training states
training_gates.each_phase_harmful_count_max: A harmful count on same phase

folds: Three leave-one-start-out folds. Fit on two entire starting-phase episodes, evaluate the third. No random 5 ms sample splits.
no_feasible_training_candidate: Record failed selection and use explicit off/A as diagnostic held-out fallback. Do not promote a nearest miss or count fallback as a successful fit.
OOF_success: Every fold must have a qualified training fit. Concatenated held-out predictions must pass the same pooled gates plus each-phase error/harm gates. Relative harm reduction is unscorable when a phase has no A harmful examples; retain that flag and use nonincrease for that phase. Pooled opportunities are nonzero.
full_data_fit: Apply identical feasibility/selection rule to all three episodes only as descriptive retrospective fit. Never label it held-out performance or select held-out metrics for fold tie-breaking.
tradeoff_reports: Publish all grid counts and point metrics, feasible counts by fold/full data, and descriptive conditional minima/frontier tradeoffs even if no setting qualifies. Do not change criteria after inspection.
oracle_scope: Stored oracle geometry uses observed total force and truth dominant-family point. Diagnostic only; not full true generalized force or a tuning acceptance gate.
new_simulation: None in this offline tuning iteration. Any promising candidate still requires a fresh episode before live adoption.
replay: Preserve source and input SHA256 before sweep. Compact NumPy inputs plus exact integer count/policy replay and point-metric comparison; record NumPy version and numeric tolerances. Cross-version floating point metrics may differ by roundoff; do not replace reported values.
pre_execution_design_clarification: Before source/input freeze or new data arithmetic, point mask clarified from raw-proposed-point finite to actual fixed A-policy point finite; unaccepted invalid proposals must not remove native-fallback rows. No numeric outcomes were consumed.
